If bid all 21.25, opponent 2 could outbid with 34. But bids are hidden and single shot per player. Bid high — say 20 alashi (choice 37) leaves cash for later. Risk: opponent bids more. Their cash 34.1 could bid 30+. But spending 30 on license worth avg ~40 (20-60, paid supera to bank share) is marginal. Opponents "react to state" — likely they'll bid moderately. Bid 20 keeps 1.25 cash.
